messages:
sasha: Quick company-wide note for Private/VPC teams: rolling out Security Hardening Pack 1.0 to on-prem and VPC fleets tonight. This includes stricter default firewall rules, automated CIS checks, and an opt-in FIPS crypto mode. Read below for action items.
kevin: Nice. Any required customer action for FIPS mode?
sasha: FIPS is opt-in per-tenant. Customers using custom integrators that rely on non-FIPS ciphers may need to validate before enabling. We will not flip anyone without consent.
mina: Ops/infra notes: rollout window 22:00-23:30 PT. We will push agent v1.14 to offline buckets; agent will perform local CIS checks and report status to the console. If customers have strict maintenance windows, PS should book slots.
infra: Installer snippet for enabling FIPS via tenant API:
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://private.redwood/api/v1/projects/555 \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"fips_mode": true}'
```
sasha: Compliance: we added a new audit flag audit_hardening=true which records CIS check results to tenant audit logs for 365 days by default. Customers can reduce retention via settings.
compliance-bot: compliance-bot: Note: for FedRAMP customers, enable FIPS + audit_hardening to meet control baselines. Legal to review messaging before customer emails.
kevin: Deployment note: staging rollout passed smoke tests; small perf impact (~1-2% CPU) on old agents. We'll monitor CPU and revert if >5% on any pool.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: security-pack/1.0 -> prod started on pool-3 at 1782655400 :rocket:
csm-bot: PS-bot: If customers need scheduled maintenance for agent bump, book /book-onprem-ps <customer> — slots open Thurs 09:00-11:00 and Fri 14:00-16:00.
mina: Action items recap: 1) Legal review customer copy (sasha + compliance-bot) 2) CSM send pre-notice to tenants with maintenance windows (csm-bot) 3) PS to offer booked windows for customers needing agent pause 4) Infra monitor CPU and revert threshold.
sasha: Thanks team. We'll post a short KB by morning and run a 15-min post-rollout check at 00:00 PT. Reply here if you see any blocked tenants or unexpected audit churn. :shield:
